routes.name: Faiz Ahmad Faiz (Peshawar Morr) - Islamabad International Airport
routes.notes: Opened 18 Apr 2022 (25.6 km). Station list from Safar (FAF Bay 3 -> N-5) plus Airport terminus; coordinates from OSM platform nodes. Name mapping uncertain: OSM "G10 Metro Station" = Safar "High Court Metro Station"/"G-10 Metro Station"; OSM "G-12 west nust station" assumed = Safar "G-13 Metro Station"; OSM "G13 Golra Metro Station" assumed = "Golra Morr Metro Station"; OSM "N5 Metro Station" = 26 Number Chungi. Safar (2026) shows the BRT service ending at N-5 with a separate "Orange Line Airport Express" N-5 <-> Airport (Rs 90); news sites also quote Rs 90 for 26 No Chungi-Airport. Whether through buses still run to the airport is unverified. Wikipedia table lists 7 stations at opening. OSM route colour=orange.

open_questions: Red Line fare: Rs 40 from 26 Mar 2026 per 24NewsHD/PakWheels; Safar still shows Rs 30. No PMA notification found.
Orange Line: does the BRT still run through to Islamabad International Airport, or terminate at N-5 with a separate Airport Express (Rs 90)?
Orange Line OSM station name mapping (G-12 west NUST vs G-13; G13 Golra vs Golra Morr) needs on-ground check.
FR-05: CDA table says Golra Morh-Taxila, timetable says NUST-D-12, Safar omits it. Current status unknown.

FR-04A: CDA = Bari Imam-QAU; Safar = Bari Imam-Barakahu. FR-06 end (Golra Sharif vs E-11 Markaz), FR-11 end (I-14 vs I-16/4), FR-03A end (Flower Market vs Saidpur) differ between CDA timetable PDFs and CDA table/Safar.
EX-16 and FR-17 found only on Safar; FR-08B only on CDA map + Safar. Launch dates for FR-01, FR-05, FR-06, FR-08B, FR-08C, FR-11, FR-13, FR-14, FR-14A, FR-15 not confirmed.
FR-02 (Sohan-AOU) and FR-03B (PIMS-NL via Margalla Road) appear in CDA map legend but have no timetable - likely future/unlaunched; excluded.

Rawalpindi electric buses: no official route numbers; Dawn (2026) said 7 routes operating but only 6 identified; Phase-II routes (Rawat T-Chowk-District Courts, Koral Chowk-Soan Bridge/Motorway/Railway Station/Saddar) status unknown.
Current concessions (students/seniors) on CDA buses and card payment options unverified.
Official line colour hex codes unknown (OSM tags colour=red/orange only).
